name: aiInteractions
description: Copilot and AI app interactions, grouped as you choose (time, user, AI app, app host, sensitivity label), with the sensitivity labels of the data they reach (needs Defender for Cloud Apps with the Microsoft 365 connector)

postBody.Query:
let binSize = {{ (new Date(timeframe.end) - new Date(timeframe.start)) <= 86400000 ? '1h' : '1d' }};
let groups = dynamic({{ JSON.stringify(((typeof groupBy === 'undefined' || groupBy === null) ? ['time', 'aiApp'] : [].concat(groupBy).map((m) => (m && typeof m === 'object') ? m.value : m)).filter((v) => ['time', 'user', 'aiApp', 'appHost', 'label'].includes(v))) }});
let gTime = set_has_element(groups, 'time');
let gUser = set_has_element(groups, 'user');
let gApp = set_has_element(groups, 'aiApp');
let gHost = set_has_element(groups, 'appHost');
let gLabel = set_has_element(groups, 'label');
let topLimit = {{ (() => { const n = Math.floor(Number(typeof top === 'undefined' ? 0 : top)); return n > 0 ? n : 1000000000; })() }};
let selectedLabels = dynamic({{ JSON.stringify((labels || []).map(o => [].concat(o.rawId)[0]).filter(Boolean).map(s => String(s).toLowerCase())) }});
let selectedUsers = dynamic({{ JSON.stringify((users || []).map(o => [].concat(o.rawId)[0]).filter(Boolean).map(s => String(s).toLowerCase())) }});
let selectedApps = dynamic({{ JSON.stringify((aiApps || []).map(o => [].concat(o.rawId)[0]).filter(Boolean)) }});
let needExpand = gLabel or array_length(selectedLabels) > 0;
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp between (datetime({{timeframe.start}}) .. datetime({{timeframe.end}}))
| where ActionType in ('CopilotInteraction', 'AIAppInteraction')
| extend uid = tolower(tostring(AccountObjectId))
| where array_length(selectedUsers) == 0 or set_has_element(selectedUsers, uid)
| extend raw = todynamic(RawEventData)
| extend ced = raw.CopilotEventData
| extend appId = tostring(raw.AppIdentity)
| where array_length(selectedApps) == 0 or set_has_element(selectedApps, appId)
| extend user = iff(gUser, tolower(tostring(raw.UserId)), ''), userId = iff(gUser, uid, ''), aiApp = iff(gApp, appId, ''), appHost = iff(gHost, tostring(ced.AppHost), ''), topLabel = tolower(tostring(ced.SensitivityLabelId))
| extend res = iff(array_length(ced.AccessedResources) > 0, ced.AccessedResources, dynamic([]))
| extend labelSet = iff(needExpand, set_union(extract_all('"sensitivitylabelid":"([0-9a-f-]+)"', tolower(tostring(res))), iff(isempty(topLabel), dynamic([]), pack_array(topLabel))), dynamic([]))
| extend jailbreak = tostring(ced.Messages) has '"JailbreakDetected":true'
| extend rs = array_concat(res, pack_array(bag_pack('sentinel', true, 'SensitivityLabelId', topLabel)))
| project Timestamp, user, userId, aiApp, appHost, labelSet, jailbreak, rs
| serialize
| extend ix = row_number()
| mv-apply r = rs on (
    extend isRes = isempty(tostring(r.sentinel)), isLab = isnotempty(tostring(r.SensitivityLabelId)), rl = iff(needExpand, tolower(tostring(r.SensitivityLabelId)), '')
    | summarize resourcesAccessed = countif(isRes), labelledResources = countif(isRes and isLab), dlpPolicyMatches = countif(isRes and isnotempty(tostring(r.PolicyDetails)) and tostring(r.PolicyDetails) !in ('[]', '{}')), xpiaDetections = countif(isRes and tobool(r.XPIADetected)) by rl
)
| extend counted = iff(isnotempty(rl) or array_length(labelSet) == 0, 1, 0)
| extend pick = iff(array_length(set_intersect(labelSet, selectedLabels)) > 0, set_intersect(labelSet, selectedLabels), labelSet)
| extend primary = iff(counted == 1 and rl == iff(array_length(pick) == 0, '', tostring(array_sort_asc(pick)[0])), 1, 0)
| where counted == 1 or resourcesAccessed > 0
| where array_length(selectedLabels) == 0 or set_has_element(selectedLabels, rl)
| summarize c = max(counted), pr = max(iff(gLabel, primary, counted)), resourcesAccessed = sum(resourcesAccessed), labelledResources = sum(labelledResources), dlpPolicyMatches = sum(dlpPolicyMatches), xpiaDetections = sum(xpiaDetections), jb = max(toint(jailbreak)) by ix, timestamp = iff(gTime, bin(Timestamp, binSize), datetime({{timeframe.start}})), user, userId, aiApp, appHost, sensitivityLabelId = iff(gLabel, rl, '')
| summarize interactions = sum(c), uniqueInteractions = sum(pr), resourcesAccessed = sum(resourcesAccessed), labelledResources = sum(labelledResources), dlpPolicyMatches = sum(dlpPolicyMatches), xpiaDetections = sum(xpiaDetections), jailbreakAttempts = sumif(pr, jb == 1) by timestamp, user, userId, aiApp, appHost, sensitivityLabelId
| extend gk = strcat(user, '|', userId, '|', aiApp, '|', appHost, '|', sensitivityLabelId)
| as hint.materialized=true T
| join kind=leftsemi (T | summarize tot = sum(uniqueInteractions) by gk | top topLimit by tot desc | project gk) on gk
| project-away gk
| order by timestamp asc, uniqueInteractions desc

metadata.name: labelPriority
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (typeof object !== 'undefined' && object && typeof object.priority !== 'undefined') ? object.priority : null }}

ui.name: groupBy
ui.label: Group by
ui.help: Sets what each row represents. Fewer dimensions return a smaller, faster result.

ui.name: top
ui.label: Top
ui.help: Keeps only the N groups with the most unique interactions, not counting time. Leave empty for all groups.
